description: Sets variant properties (e.g. Size, State, Color) on a component instance. Use figma_inspect (target: "variants") first to see available properties/values for the component set. Params: nodeId (required), properties (required, key-value map e.g. { "Size": "Large" }). Requires Phase 2. Tracks replay success/failure for the knowledge store's recipe learning.
name: figma_set_variant
